Checked and passing: app_open/session_start/screen_view/identify (uid is a lowercase website UUID), only the X-JL-Key pk_ header with no Authorization, no phone/PIN/name/token in props or context, no forbidden event names, feature_entry_viewed for misfire/choice/mission/performance/store/leagues/gangs, series_slot_viewed, test_card_viewed, result_viewed, analysis_opened, solution_viewed, rank_tool_opened, search_performed/search_zero_results {area} without the typed text, the privacy switch (default ON, exact notice, OFF -> opt_out then nothing POSTed over 3 screens, jl_optout='1' survives a reload, ON -> opt_in and events start again, left ON), /privacy analytics section, sign-out reset (no uid and a new anon_id afterwards). Integration finding: the real collector's CORS allows only https://jeelive.ai, so the web build/preview origin cannot deliver events (native apps are not affected).

minor.issue: Error responses (HTTPException) come without Cache-Control: no-store. Only the 200 JSONResponses set NO_STORE. Low risk because the errors carry no data.
JLIVE_COLLECTOR_URL falls back to a hardcoded default URL, which goes against the env-only rule. Acceptable if this is intended.

track_server runs even when this call was not the one that completed the sprint (twin request, done=None). Only the deterministic uuid5 key 'solo:'+sid stops a double count. That is fine but relies on the collector's de-duplication.

integration_issues.issue: REPRODUCED: on the Rapid Gang tab, rapid.tsx:45 trackFeature('gangs') fires, then tapping rf-new-gang (/rapid/gang/new) or a gang (/rapid/gang/<gid>) makes FeatureTracker (featureTrack.ts:9 /^\/rapid\/gang/) fire a 2nd {feature:'gangs'}, because was.current is '' on /rapid. This breaks the 'not again for sub-pages of the same feature' rule. Fix: let FeatureTracker skip when the previous path was /rapid and the arena tab was gang (or keep one shared 'last feature' value in featureTrack for both trackers).

rapid.tsx:45 tracks only on [tab] change. The tab screen stays mounted and useArenaTab is a global store, so leaving the Rapid tab with Store/Trophy/Gang selected and coming back sends no new feature_entry_viewed. Per entry it is undercounted.

OPTIONS preflight to https://student-radar-5.emergent.host/api/collect/v1/batch: Origin https://jeelive.ai -> 204 with allow headers; Origin = the app's preview origin (or app.jeelive.ai, or none) -> 403 without CORS headers. Any web copy of the app cannot deliver events (the queue fills up, nothing arrives). Native iOS/Android send no preflight. Dashboard side: allow-list the app's web origin(s) if web tracking matters.

optOut() pushes opt_out, calls flush(), then sets q=[] at once. If a flush is already running (sending=true), or backoff (until) is active, or the POST fails, opt_out is lost and never retried. Fix: keep opt_out in the queue (q = q.filter(e => e.event_name==='opt_out')) and let push/flush allow that single event while optedOut.
screen starts as '/'. When the app opens on '/', no screen_view is sent for that first screen, only on later navigation. Fix: start screen as '' so the first path is always reported.

issues: account-analytics-switch renders 40x20 px on web. Only the switch is tappable, not the 68 px row, so it is below the 44x44 touch target. Make the whole row a Pressable that toggles, or add a hitSlop.
The notice says 'Settings > Privacy' but the screen is titled 'Account' (group 'Privacy'). The owner mandated the copy, so consider which label to use.

action_items: Fix the double feature_entry_viewed {feature:gangs} on Gang tab -> /rapid/gang/* (featureTrack.ts + rapid.tsx:45): one shared 'current feature' value for both trackers.
Optional: fire store/leagues/gangs again when the Rapid tab regains focus (useFocusEffect) so every entry is counted.
Make opt_out reliable: do not drop it when a flush is in flight, in backoff, or failed (jlTracker.ts:81).
Initialise `screen` to '' so the first screen ('/') gets a screen_view (jlTracker.ts:14).
Make the 'Share usage analytics' row fully tappable or add a hitSlop to the switch (40x20 on web).
Dashboard side (not an app bug): the collector's CORS allows only https://jeelive.ai. Add the app's web origin(s) if the web copy should be tracked.
Optional: add NO_STORE headers to CEO API error responses.
critical_code_review_comments: Server hooks follow the rules: sprints.finish after find_one_and_update + award; duels settle only `if flipped`; daily settle after award; gamify.award only when pay_once returned a profile; shop buy / rush / quest / league / squad after the guarded update (the failure paths raise before); dream only for ids that were not in the list before and only after a matched or upserted write; mission_link_created after insert_one (DuplicateKeyError skips it); mission_link_opened goes to the link OWNER uid, and an invalid or nonexistent code returns before any DB write; account_delete_requested after find_one_and_update with key 'deletion:'+id.

track_server: only website-UUID uids, secret required, scalar props capped at 30 keys / 200 chars, 2 s httpx timeout, task kept in the _running set, every exception swallowed. jl_server_check confirms it does not block or raise.

Client events seen: analysis_opened, app_background, app_open, feature_entry_viewed, heartbeat, identify, opt_in, opt_out, rank_tool_opened, result_viewed, screen_view, search_performed, search_zero_results, series_slot_viewed, session_start, solution_viewed, test_card_viewed. No account_created and no test/attempt started|submitted|resumed|expired. Note: set/[id].tsx:53 has 'test_start_clicked' (tap only). It matches the owner's list but its name is close to the banned family, so worth a confirmation.
analysis_opened fires automatically on every result load because 'analysis' is the default tab. That is acceptable per the request, but it equals result_viewed in count.

rca_of_issue: gangs double count: two independent trackers. rapid.tsx tracks the in-screen Gang tab, and FeatureTracker tracks the /rapid/gang route. FeatureTracker's was.current is '' on /rapid, so the gang sub-route counts as a new entry. Repro: sign in -> tab-rapid -> arena-tab-gang (gangs fires) -> rf-new-gang (gangs fires again).
